facts.fact: The Ethiopian Institute of Artificial Intelligence inaugurated customs systems for the Customs Commission, including a passenger risk management system and a licensing system with a chatbot serving the Commission's services in four languages (TechReviewAfrica).

systems.system: Customs warehouse and agent licensing system with multilingual chatbot
